For the Petitioner : Mr. Jitendra Shankar Singh, Advocate Mr. Sheo Kumar Singh, Advocate For the Opp. Party : Ms. Priya Shrestha, Spl.P.P.
-----
4/ 02.09.2025 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner has been made accused in connection with Hussainabad P.S. Case No. 17 of 2025 for the offences registered under Sections 366-A, 376, 109, 506, 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 4, 6, 17 and 21 of the POCSO Act, pending in the Court of learned Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO) Act, Palamau.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have raped the daughter of the informant.
4. It was submitted that the informant and victim are in habit of instituting false case of rape against different person.
FIR of Hussainabad P.S. Case No. 307 of 2022 has been brought on record to substantiate this fact.
It was further submitted that mother of the victim is also an accused for committing murder of her husband.
It was finally submitted that there is delay of one and half years in lodging the present case.
5. In view of the submission made above, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the Amresh Bharti @ Ambrish Bhartiya vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
